Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.

Executive Operations

  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.

  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.

About the opportunity

Xplor Pay is building the payments infrastructure of the future — embedded, intelligent, and designed for the verticals we serve. As Product Manager for Direct Debit & Alternate Payments, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for our UK (Bacs) and EU (SEPA) Direct Debit rails, while simultaneously leading our expansion into Open Banking, account-to-account (A2A), and emerging payment methods across the UK and European markets.

What You'll Do

Direct Debit Product Ownership (UK & EU)

  • Own and evolve the product roadmap for Bacs Direct Debit (UK) and SEPA (EU), balancing merchant experience, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Reduce failure rates, improve reconciliation flows, and drive down cost-per-transaction through product-led initiatives.
  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure adherence to UK FCA rules, EU PSD2/PSD3, GDPR, and scheme rules from Bacs, SEPA, and Pay.UK.
  • Work with the Commercial team to package and price Direct Debit as a competitive embedded payment option for Xplor's vertical SaaS partners.

Open Banking & Alternate Payments

  • Lead the product development of Open Banking payment initiation (PIS) and account information (AIS) services under UK Open Banking standards and EU PSD2/PSD3 requirements.
  • Define the roadmap for A2A payments, Variable Recurring Payments (VRP), and Request-to-Pay (RtP) as these rails mature in the UK and EU.
  • Evaluate and integrate alternate payment methods (e.g., iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA Instant, PayTo equivalents) relevant to Xplor's merchant base.

Roadmap & Strategy

  • Define quarterly and annual plans for the Direct Debit and Alternate Payments portfolio; maintain and communicate a rolling 12-month roadmap.
  • Conduct competitive analysis across incumbent acquirers, neo-banks, and specialist payment providers operating in UK/EU markets.
  • Present strategy, progress, and investment cases to the Embedded Payments executive leadership team.

Delivery & Stakeholder Management

  • Drive agile delivery with cross-functional squads — engineering, design, data, and QA — using clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Build strong relationships with external scheme operators, banks, and open banking infrastructure providers.
  • Serve as the internal centre of excellence on UK/EU payment rails — educating sales, customer success, and commercial teams.

AI-Augmented Product Practice

jobs.jd_full:
What we want to accomplish and why we need you

Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions.  Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we’re striving to do even better. Come and join us!

We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctor. We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. Check out this short video to learn more about our mission and our culture.

About the Role:

As Technical Program Manager, your primary role is to drive the successful technical integration of Suki with our major health system and health technology clients.  You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, and ensuring that Suki’s integration delivers exceptionally well on key success metrics.  You will partner with your Suki colleagues to optimize on-time delivery and resolve technical challenges. Throughout each client deployment, you will guide technical stakeholders through the steps needed to establish a seamless integration between Suki and their EMR.

Besides guiding the integration process, this individual will be responsible for testing the integration and green-lighting each integration stage, escalating issues when needed. As Suki’s resident expert on its integrations, you will establish and maintain internal and external-facing documentation detailing the integration requirements and process for each EMR with which Suki integrates. Partnering with a Customer Success team member, you will be the technical point person for each integration and as the client-facing technical resource, set expectations for the client to identify and engage with the technical resources necessary for a successful integration with their EMR. Internally, this entails close collaboration with Engineering to solve technical challenges and develop/maintain robust test plans which will support proactive discovery and resolution for potential issues before go-live. Similarly, this individual will also be tightly aligned with Product to share new EMR constraints, gaps and learnings that will help keep our products up to date. We seek professionals who think critically, solve complex problems, and are dedicated to building and sustaining high-performing, client-focused solutions.

Position Overview

The Program Manager is responsible for providing program and project management oversight across complex client initiatives across multiple, large federal defense programs while supporting requirements analysis, operational planning, pricing activities, and financial performance. This client-facing role serves as a key partner to leadership, project teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful execution of program objectives, alignment of resources, and delivery of high-quality solutions.

The Program Manager will oversee program performance by monitoring schedules, risks, deliverables, project financials, and resource utilization across multiple initiatives. This role requires the ability to analyze technical direction, client requirements, and project objectives to develop actionable plans, support pricing and cost estimating efforts, and maintain visibility into program performance through forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of program management, business analysis, project financial management, and stakeholder engagement experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive projects from planning through execution in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

This role involves executing both program-level management and oversight as well as project-level execution support.

Program Management:

  • Lead and oversee program execution across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.

  • Serve as a primary client-facing point of contact, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and facilitating clear communication across teams.

  • Build trust with the client and cultivate a strong relationship to drive the relationship from MSLLC being a “safe pair of hands” to a “trusted advisor.”

  • Work closely with MSLLC’s Account and Relationship Leads to ensure program performance is on budget and meeting revenue and profitability targets, as well as identifying potential opportunities for account growth.

  • Develop a growth plan strategy for the program, in connection with the MSLLC Account and Relationship Leads. Pressure test key assumptions to ensure realistic achievement and coordinate across the team to determine the most viable pathways for growth.

  • Collaborate closely with project managers, leadership, and contract teams to assess funding needs, resource allocation, and project execution strategies.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, internal processes, and applicable regulations while maintaining accurate project documentation and reporting.

  • Facilitate meetings, briefings, and presentations with internal and external stakeholders to communicate priorities, recommendations, and program status.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We’re building a future for the Internet that’s easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we’re backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own what it’s like to build a Tailscale-native application — software with Tailscale connectivity and identity built in from the start.

You’d own the original front door to that world: TSNet, the Go library that puts a Tailscale node inside an application in a few lines of code; tailscale-rs, our new Rust-based SDK family (including C++, Python, and Elixir); the tailscale CLI powering scripting, automation, and CI; and the core Tailscale client library.

Products already get built this way, inside and outside Tailscale. Aperture, our AI connectivity gateway, and Tailscale PAM run on these primitives. So do LM Studio, NVIDIA, and Namespace.co, who embed Tailscale directly into their applications to give their users secure remote access, reach into customer networks safely, and bridge cloud environments without VPN gymnastics. One of those teams went from zero to a working embedded integration in hours. Your job is to make that the normal outcome for thousands of more applications.

Today this experience is engineering-led and the developer journey is uneven. The API is powerful, but the on-ramp from “I read a blog post” to “Tailscale is running inside my product” has real friction: auth key handling, onboarding flows designed for humans instead of embedded apps, docs and examples that don’t yet tell a coherent story. You’ll own that journey end to end and define, concretely, what it means to build a Tailscale-native application including the golden paths, the reference patterns, the APIs, and the developer experience that makes people say “wait, that’s all it took?”

You’ll report to Ross Kukulinski, VP Product, and work closely with the Rust, Golang, and Clients engineering teams, plus the internal product teams and external partners building Tailscale-Native Applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for the native apps experience: TSNet, tailscale-rs, and the tailscale CLI
  • Define what “Tailscale-native application” means — the reference architectures, golden paths, and embedding patterns, packaged as docs, examples, and sample apps developers can build from
  • Own the developer experience end to end: the on-ramp from blog post to running embedded node, API ergonomics, error messages, docs that work, examples that compile, and upgrade paths that don’t burn early adopters
  • Set the Rust SDK family strategy: which TSNet capabilities to port, which to skip, in what order, and how to position the library to developers.
  • Treat the CLI as a product in its own right: scripting ergonomics, output conventions, automation surfaces, and the experience for platform and SRE teams running tailscale in CI and infrastructure-as-code
  • Run the internal dogfood loop. Aperture and Tailscale PAM are built on these primitives; make those teams your most demanding customers and turn their friction into roadmap.
  • Partner with GTM and Customer Success on embedding deals — AI platforms, developer tools, and infrastructure software shipping Tailscale inside their products — and let what you learn set priorities
  • Engage developers where they live (GitHub issues, Discord, office hours) and build a coherent picture of what embedded developers need

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years in product management, or a software engineering background moving into product, with real time spent on a developer-facing product: an SDK, API, CLI, library, or developer tool
  • You’ve shipped developer-facing features that developers used in production, and lived with the consequences of your design choices — naming, defaults, error behavior, versioning
  • You can read Go and/or Rust and hold a credible technical conversation about API and SDK design
  • You have taste in developer experience: opinions about API ergonomics, docs, error messages, and getting-started flows, with examples to back them up
  • You do customer research the way developer products require it — reading GitHub issues, lurking in Discord, running office hours, and finding the pattern in the noise
  • You turn ambiguous scope into shipped increments, close the loop after launch, and keep teams informed along the way

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on Go or Rust experience — you’ve built something real, even as a side project
  • Time at a developer platform company with a strong SDK motion (e.g. Stripe, Twilio, Auth0, Vercel, Supabase, HashiCorp)
  • Open-source community experience: contributor experience, issue triage, balancing commercial priorities with community needs
  • Enough networking, zero-trust, or VPN familiarity to understand what embedding Tailscale does for a developer
  • Experience designing CLIs or scripting surfaces for platform and SRE teams
  • Public technical writing, talks, OSS contributions, or developer-tooling side projects
  • LLMs and coding agents as part of your daily product workflow
